description: Source code for the MacroExpander class in the ANGLE project, implementing macro expansion logic for a preprocessor.

classes.name: TokenLexer
classes.description: A lexer that tokenizes a vector of tokens for macro expansion.

classes.name: MacroExpander::ScopedMacroReenabler
classes.description: A RAII class that temporarily disables macro re-enabling during its lifetime.

classes.name: MacroExpander::MacroContext
classes.description: Represents a macro expansion context with tokens and current index.

methods.name: MacroExpander::lex
methods.description: Retrieves the next token, handling macro expansion and special tokens.

methods.name: MacroExpander::getToken
methods.description: Gets the next token, considering macro contexts and reserve tokens.

methods.name: MacroExpander::ungetToken
methods.description: Pushes back a token into the stream.

methods.name: MacroExpander::isNextTokenLeftParen
methods.description: Checks if the next token is a left parenthesis.

methods.name: MacroExpander::pushMacro
methods.description: Begins expansion of a macro, pushing a new context.

methods.name: MacroExpander::popMacro
methods.description: Ends macro expansion context, re-enabling macros if deferred.

methods.name: MacroExpander::expandMacro
methods.description: Expands a macro into a list of tokens.

methods.name: MacroExpander::replaceMacroParams
methods.description: Replaces macro parameters with argument tokens.
